senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
ex.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

ex.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

col: go to the gym｜去健身房
tip: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。

ex.en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。

tip: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.en: To do something with a tool, resource, or method.
The act of employing something for a purpose.
A purpose something serves or a way it can help.

ex.en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？

ex.en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。

col: use public transport｜使用公共交通
a wide range of uses｜多种用途
tip: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

senses.en: a group of things sharing particular features
to enter words using a keyboard

ex.en: What type of bread would you like today?
ex.zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？

ex.en: Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 城市和农村社区都需要不同类型的公共交通服务。

col: type a message｜打字输入消息
tip: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。

senses.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

ex.en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。

ex.en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
ex.zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

tip: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

senses.en: feeling fear or worry about something
used to introduce unwelcome information politely

ex.en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。

ex.en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。

col: afraid of making mistakes｜害怕犯错
tip: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

senses.zh: 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色）
senses.en: not happy, especially because something unpleasant has happened

ex.en: Sorry to hear the sad news.
ex.zh: 听到这令人伤心的消息我很难过。

senses.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

ex.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
ex.zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。

ex.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

tip: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

senses.en: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life

ex.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
ex.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

ex.en: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
ex.zh: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

senses.en: going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something

ex.en: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
ex.zh: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: to run or move after someone to catch them
to try hard to obtain something you want
an attempt to catch someone by following them

ex.en: Our puppy chased a leaf across the garden.
ex.zh: 我们的小狗追着一片叶子跑过花园。

ex.en: Many young professionals chase higher salaries rather than seek work that offers lasting satisfaction.
ex.zh: 许多年轻的专业人士追求更高的薪水，而不是寻找能带来持久满足感的工作。

tip: chase可直接接追赶对象，也可用chase after。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

ex.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

col: hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

tip: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

senses.en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable.
Not morally acceptable or fair.
In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

col: something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

senses.en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief.
Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position.
The quality something has when touched or experienced.

ex.en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
ex.zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。

ex.en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
ex.zh: 当公共空间照明充足且由地方政府定期维护时，居民往往更有安全感。

col: feel strongly about｜对……有强烈看法
feel like doing something｜想做某事
get a feel for｜逐渐了解
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为felt；feel后可直接接形容词。

senses.en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom
to be in a particular place or position
to take an examination

ex.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
ex.zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。

ex.en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
ex.zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

senses.en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

senses.en: notice a sound through your ears
receive information about something
listen formally to evidence or arguments

ex.en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
ex.zh: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。

ex.en: Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对公共交通作出重大调整前，应听取居民的顾虑。

col: hear from someone｜收到某人的消息
hear both sides｜听取双方意见
tip: hear强调听见；listen to强调主动听。过去式heard。

senses.en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.

ex.en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。

ex.en: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
ex.zh: 蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。

tip: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

ex.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
ex.zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。

ex.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

tip: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

senses.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

ex.en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。

ex.en: Heavy rainfall can turn unpaved roads into mud, making rural communities difficult to reach.
ex.zh: 强降雨会使未铺装的道路变得泥泞，导致农村社区交通不便。

col: get stuck in the mud｜陷在泥里
tip: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

col: pull a door open｜把门拉开
tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

tip: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

senses.en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils
a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
ex.zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。

tip: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

col: halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres.
A regular pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in poetry.

ex.en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
ex.zh: 这个架子长一米多一点。

ex.en: Raising coastal barriers by one metre could help protect nearby homes from increasingly severe flooding.
ex.zh: 将海岸屏障加高一米，有助于保护附近住宅免受日益严重的洪水侵袭。

tip: 长度单位英式写metre，美式写meter；复数metres。

senses.en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

tip: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

col: protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

senses.en: below something else in position, level, or amount
to move something down or reduce its level

ex.en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
ex.zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。

ex.en: Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。

tip: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

senses.en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light.
To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.

ex.en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。

ex.en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
ex.zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。

tip: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex.zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

ex.en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。

col: become increasingly important｜变得日益重要
tip: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials
cut something using a saw
past tense of see: noticed or looked at something

ex.en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
ex.zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。

ex.en: The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 过去十年，公共交通取得了显著改善，尤其是在快速发展的城市地区。

col: saw something in half｜把某物锯成两半
tip: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。

senses.en: On the day before today.
The day immediately before today.

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天把雨伞落在公交车上了。

ex.en: The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
ex.zh: 昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。

tip: yesterday前通常不用介词，常与一般过去时连用。

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex.zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

ex.en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。

col: before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

ex.en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
ex.zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。

ex.en: A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
ex.zh: 专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。

tip: 可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms

ex.en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
ex.zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。

ex.en: Building a new hotel near the station could create jobs and attract more visitors to the area.
ex.zh: 在车站附近新建一家酒店可以创造就业机会，并吸引更多游客前来。

tip: 表示住酒店可用stay at或stay in a hotel。

senses.en: set and not changing or adjustable
securely attached in one position

ex.en: This cafe offers lunch at a fixed price.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆以固定价格供应午餐。

ex.en: Workers on fixed incomes may struggle to afford basic necessities when inflation significantly increases the cost of living.
ex.zh: 当通货膨胀大幅推高生活成本时，收入固定的劳动者可能难以负担基本生活必需品。

tip: fixed price是固定价格；fixed也可作fix的过去分词。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: A device that produces light, often on a table.

ex.en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她打开了床边的灯。

ex.en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
ex.zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。

tip: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

senses.en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard.
With a strong sound that is easily heard.

ex.en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
ex.zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。

ex.en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。

col: loud and clear｜响亮而清楚地
tip: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

senses.en: get pleasure from an activity or experience
have something good, such as a right or advantage

ex.en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。

ex.en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

tip: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

ex.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

col: a gift for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: away from a place or position
away from or no longer touching something
not operating or not working at a particular time

ex.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
ex.zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。

ex.en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
ex.zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。

tip: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

senses.en: used as the past tense of ‘can’ to say what someone was able to do or was allowed to do in the past

ex.en: I could do it, he mused.
ex.zh: 我能做这件事，他沉思着。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens
a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。

ex.en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

tip: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex.en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。

tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

senses.en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials
The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it

ex.en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。

ex.en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
ex.zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。

col: a basket of fruit｜一篮水果
tip: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

senses.zh: 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段
senses.en: a piece or feature of something such as an object, area, event, or period of time
to move the two sides of something apart, or to move apart, making a space in the middle

ex.en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
ex.zh: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
ex.zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
ex.zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。

col: a long time ago｜很久以前
as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。
